items.title: Sheila Jordan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: But he was the saxophone player on that.

ctx.x: Paul Plummer. Wonderful player. From Ohio. I saw him years later. I was out there doing a gig and he was in, he came in, and it was great to see him. Uh, but very quiet kinda guy. Kind of even strange in a sense. In a beautiful way. But he was the saxophone player on that.
Did you rehearse in the studio, and how many takes?
